description: The Open Agent Rules 1.0 conformance corpus. Each fixture replays one anchor occurrence, or an ordered run of them, against one rule set on the host its own input.capability describes, and states the decision a conforming engine must produce. A fixture marked baseline declares a capability set nothing conforming lacks, and may not be skipped ([OAR-CONF-35]).
